title: Storefront audit: Production baseline and isolated UX evidence
summary: Read-only audit of the current Production storefront. Evidence collection is complete for repeated Playwright measurements, five responsive widths and mocked cart/checkout checks; Lighthouse and final report review remain in progress. No application source or deployment changes.

changes.detail: New isolated audit directory containing source reconciliation, 24 cold-cache lab samples, screenshots, axe evidence, keyboard checks and synthetic cart/checkout failure observations. No application source modified, removed or fixed.
